title: Austin City Council Meeting May 1890
summary:
• **Low attendance**: Only 8 of 20 aldermen showed up for the meeting, with 12 absent.

• **Quick adjournment**: The council immediately moved to adjourn with a narrow 5-3 vote, suggesting minimal business to conduct.

• **No substantive agenda items**: The meeting minutes contain no discussion of policies, public hearings, or city business—only procedural matters.
transcript:
637

The minutes of a Regular meeting of the City Council.

Austin, Tex. May 19, 1890.
Hon. John McDonald, mayor, presiding.

Roll Call- Present- Aldermen - Carleton,
Hume, Jackson, Jones, Morris, North,
Platt, Ziller - 8.

Absent Aldermen- Anderson, Assmann,
Boland, Graham, Linn, Metz, Newton,
Nitschke, Phillips, Schneider, Schuber, Townsend-12.

Alderman Platt moved to adjourn and the
motion prevailed by the following vote-
Yeas- Aldermen- Hume,
Jackson, Jones, North, Platt- 5.
Nays- Aldermen - Carleton, Morris, Ziller- 3. Milton Morris,
City Clerk.
